run_cprofile_decorator: run the cprofile decorator to profile a Python function with cProfile and print stats to stdout
run_cprofile_decorator_save: run the cprofile decorator to profile a Python function and save results to a stats file
run_cprofile_decorator_disabled: run the cprofile decorator with enabled=false to skip profiling and execute the function directly
run_cprofile_context: run the cprofile_context context manager to profile a block of code and print cumulative time stats
run_cprofile_context_save: run the cprofile_context context manager to profile a block of code and dump stats to a file
